status: derived from Amazon's published kernel source; NOT verified on any device

source.origin: Kindle_src_5.10.1.1 (Amazon GPL source release), re-uploaded; README states compatibility with PW2, PW3, KV, KT2 (imx60_wario_defconfig) and KOA (imx60_duet_defconfig)
source.not_covered: Kindle Basic 2024 (KT6) and every device newer than these: they need the kernel source of their own firmware release

soc.value: NXP/Freescale i.MX 6SoloLite (SOC_IMX6SL, ARM Cortex-A9 single core, ARMv7)

kernel.build: needs patches/lab126-3.0.35/0001 for GCC 13 + binutils 2.42 (see kernel/patches); image types zImage; U-Boot uImage wrapping is done by the Amazon build, not verified here

boot_interface.cmdline_default: rootwait log_pos_goal=0x8fff0000 console=ttymxc0,115200 root=/dev/mmcblk0p1 ro ip=off quiet video=mxcepdcfb:E60,bpp=8,x_mem=3M
boot_interface.note: board id, serial, MAC and boot mode reach the kernel as ATAGs from the bootloader and are exposed as /proc/board_id, /proc/usid, /proc/mac_addr, /proc/bootmode. Any replacement boot chain has to pass them.

board_id.format: 16-char string; characters 3..5 select the board variant, the rest the revision (BOARD_IS_ macros)
board_id.mapping_to_marketing_names: NOT in the source; must be established from real devices (/proc/board_id) before any identification rule is written

display.userspace_api: include/linux/mxcfb.h: MXCFB_SEND_UPDATE (_IOW 'F' 0x2E), MXCFB_WAIT_FOR_UPDATE_COMPLETE (_IOWR 'F' 0x2F), MXCFB_SET_WAVEFORM_MODES, MXCFB_SET_TEMPERATURE, MXCFB_SET_AUTO_UPDATE_MODE, MXCFB_SET_UPDATE_SCHEME, MXCFB_SET_PWRDOWN_DELAY
display.note: the panel in use is chosen at runtime (panel id); which physical device uses which panel is not stated in the source. Waveform data is loaded as firmware (not in the source tree).

drivers: cyttsp4 (Cypress TrueTouch gen4, I2C 0x24, modules TOUCHSCREEN_CYPRESS_CYTTSP4*, uses firmware binary)

pmic.chip: Maxim MAX77696 (I2C 0, bus address MAX77696_I2C_ADDR) providing: battery gauge, charger, frontlight driver, LEDs, RTC, on-key, display/VCOM supplies, GPIO

sysfs.note: names come from the driver source (MAX77696_PSY_BATT_NAME, MAX77696_CHARGER_NAME, MAX77696_BL_NAME); the backlight misc device 'frontlight' also exists. wifi operstate depends on the interface name chosen by the Wi-Fi driver.

wifi_bt.base_variant: Atheros AR6003 / ath6kl over SDIO (usdhc3, modules ATH6KL, AR6003)

storage.emmc: usdhc2 (index 1), 8-bit, always present; boot partition switching patches (eMMC boot partition) in patches/
storage.root: root=/dev/mmcblk0p1 (ro) in the default cmdline; diagnostics image uses mmcblk0p2 (Makefile.lab126)
storage.partition_table_beyond_this: not in the kernel source; must be read from a real device (tools/hwdiag.sh)
storage.falcon: CONFIG_FALCON (fast boot, bios address 0x9F5F0000) enabled only in imx60_duet_defconfig

usb: ARC USB OTG gadget (USB_GADGET_ARC), g_serial module in defconfig; mass-storage gadget would need g_mass_storage or configfs-equivalent legacy module in 3.0.35 (no configfs gadget API)
rtc: MAX77696 RTC plus i.MX SNVS RTC
